answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lockup. An attacker attempting to flood the network from the frozen tundra of anonymity must sacrifice significant liquidity to stake tokens, pushing them off the ledge of profitability. By requiring this financial commitment, the protocol forces the adversary to expend resources equivalent to the juniper shrub’s resilience, ensuring that each identity remains economically tethered to tangible assets.
